title: Compliance & Security
summary: GDPR compliance, data privacy, immutable audit trails, Fair Hiring AI and security controls.
headline: Hire with confidence. *Your data is protected.*
lede: Recruitment involves some of the most sensitive personal data a company handles. TalentPool365 is built to help you protect that data, follow privacy regulations and keep AI-assisted hiring fair and transparent.
sectionIntro: Recruitment involves some of the most sensitive personal data a company handles. TalentPool365 is built to help you protect that data, follow privacy regulations and keep AI-assisted hiring fair and transparent.

capabilities.title: GDPR Compliance
capabilities.tagline: Built to support your data protection obligations.
capabilities.body: Hiring teams need to handle candidate data lawfully. TalentPool365 gives you the tools to collect, use and delete personal data in line with GDPR requirements.
points: Candidate consent capture and tracking
Data retention rules with automatic deletion
Easy handling of access, correction and deletion requests
Clear records of how and why data is processed

capabilities.title: Data Privacy
capabilities.tagline: Candidate data stays private, and in the right hands.
capabilities.body: Only the people who need to see candidate information can see it. Your data is never sold, and you stay in control of how it is used.
points: Role-based access to candidate and hiring data
Encryption of data in transit and at rest
Sensitive details can be restricted or masked
Transparent privacy notices for candidates

capabilities.title: Audit Trails
capabilities.tagline: A clear record of every action and decision.
capabilities.body: Know who did what, and when. Every important action in the platform is logged, which supports internal reviews, compliance checks and accountability.
points: Activity logs for candidate, job and offer changes
Records of approvals, feedback and hiring decisions
Searchable history by user, date or action
Exportable logs for audits and reviews

capabilities.title: Fair Hiring AI
capabilities.tagline: AI that supports fair decisions, with people in charge.
capabilities.body: Our AI is designed to help recruiters evaluate candidates on skills and job-relevant criteria. Final hiring decisions always stay with your team.
points: Evaluation focused on skills and job-related requirements
Explainable scores so you can see why a candidate ranked as they did
Ongoing monitoring for bias in screening outcomes
Human review at key decision points

capabilities.title: Security Controls
capabilities.tagline: Enterprise-grade protection for your hiring data.
capabilities.body: Strong safeguards protect your platform and your candidates’ information from unauthorized access.
points: Secure login with multi-factor authentication
User permissions and access management
Regular backups and secure data storage
Monitoring to detect and respond to suspicious activity

outcomes.label: human oversight on all hiring decisions
AES encryption for data in transit and rest
candidate data shared with third parties

closingCta.headline: Trust is part of every hire.
closingCta.body: Talk to us about how TalentPool365 protects your data and supports compliant, fair hiring.
